request.style: English, triumphant cinematic anthem, a massive choir, pipe organ and full orchestra with brass and timpani, a broad build to a thunderous final chorus, victorious major key, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I heard what seemed to be the voice of a great multitude
Like the roar of many waters
And like the sound of mighty peals of thunder
Crying out

[Chorus]
Hallelujah, for the Lord our God
The Almighty reigns
Hallelujah, hallelujah
The Lord our God reigns

[Verse]
Let us rejoice and exult
And give him the glory
For the marriage of the Lamb has come
And his bride has made herself ready

[Chorus]
Hallelujah, for the Lord our God
The Almighty reigns
Hallelujah, hallelujah
The Lord our God reigns
